scientific_integrity: Finite transfer-matrix and exact polynomial certificates are accompanied by a complete mathematical argument. Source comparison establishes qualified best-knowledge originality, not exhaustive publication priority.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to dyadic prefixes and prime moduli 2,3,5,7,11 only. At eleven, only a strict lower bound is proved for the root-growth limsup, not an exact exponent; it does not classify all larger primes. Exact matrix certificates need independent review before independent validation.
title: The first prime square-root discrepancy failure for consecutive Stern residues
